jd:
Capital Technology Group provides expert consulting services software development, digital transformation, human-centered design, data analytics and visualization, and cybersecurity.  

 Our multidisciplinary teams use agile methodologies to rapidly and incrementally deliver value in close collaboration with our clients. For over a decade, we have been trusted by both federal and commercial clients to solve complex, mission-critical business challenges. The quality of our work has been recognized by our partners and peers through our inclusion in the Digital Services Coalition, a group of forward- thinking firms recognized for excellence in delivering IT services.

 Description 

 Spend your summer shipping real software. In Capital Technology Group's 8-week hybrid internship, you'll first join an agile team building features for a live CTG Labs product. Then you'll pitch and build your own AI-powered project, with mentorship from CTG engineers and a Claude license for AI-assisted development.

 We're looking for curious, driven undergraduate and graduate students who love to build. You won't be fetching coffee or watching from the sidelines. You'll own real features on projects that support mission-critical work, side by side with experienced engineers who are invested in your success.

 🛠️ What you'll build: Two phases, one summer. In weeks 1 to 4, you'll work as an agile team shipping features off the backlog of a live CTG Labs product, likely across Python, React, and AWS, while shaping a pitch for your own project. In weeks 5 to 8, you'll design, build, and ship that AI-powered project yourself, aimed at a real problem in the federal space.

 🤝 Who you'll build with: You'll join a summer cohort of software development, data engineering, and business development interns. Look forward to a weekly speaker series with CTG engineers and leaders covering software fundamentals, DevOps, data workflows, and user-centered design, plus career training on resumes, interviewing, and networking.

 🎤 How you'll finish: The summer wraps with Final Demo Day, where you present your AI project to the company and show off everything you learned along the way.

 📅 The details: 8 weeks, full time (40 hours per week), June 21 through August 13. Hybrid, with 3 days together in our Silver Spring, Maryland office and the rest of the week remote.

 Your Path to CTG 

 📍 Location: Hybrid, Silver Spring, MD You'll join us in the office 3 days a week, so make sure you can commute to Silver Spring this summer.

 🚨 Deadline: Monday, January 4 at 11:59 PM ET Don't wait! We review applications on a rolling basis and may close early, so the sooner you apply, the better.

 💥 Take-Home Challenge Selected candidates get a take-home challenge, your chance to show us how you build. You'll have one week to accept the invite and up to 3 days to complete it once you start.

 📞 December and January: Let's Connect! If you advance, you'll have a short call with our recruiting team, followed by interviews with our team. Interviews happen on a rolling basis and may start as early as December, with most taking place in January.

 🎉 By Tuesday, February 2 Offers go out, and we officially welcome you to the Capital Technology Group team!

 At CTG, you'll earn while you learn, work alongside a team that champions creativity and innovation, and gain hands-on experience that sets you apart. You'll grow your portfolio, connect with mentors and peers, and take on exciting challenges in a supportive environment. Along the way, you'll celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and have a blast doing meaningful work that impacts millions of people. Ready to create, innovate, and grow? We want you on our team!

 What You'll Be Doing 

• Build and ship features with a collaborative, agile team working in Scrum sprints, owning work that makes a real impact 

• Kick off your days with stand-ups and team syncs where your ideas and progress truly count 

• Pitch your own AI-powered project, then own it end to end: design, build, deploy, and demo, with 1:1 mentorship from a CTG engineer 

• Use your CTG-provided Claude license to get up to speed in a new codebase fast and build with AI assistance 

• Team up with fellow interns to crack problems, swap ideas, and learn from each other 

• Jump into code reviews, brainstorms, and technical discussions, and learn straight from industry experts in our weekly speaker series 

• Join the team in the Silver Spring office 3 days a week for hands-on collaboration, in-person learning, and good company 

• Show off your progress at sprint demos every other Friday and take the stage at Final Demo Day 
 
 What You'll Bring 

• US Citizen 

• Living in the DC Metro area 

• College student majoring in Computer Science or a related field (priority given to rising seniors) 

• At least two past software development projects in an accessible Git repository (school or personal projects that show off your technical skills) 

• Familiarity with Java or Python 

• Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React 

• Comfortable navigating the Linux shell and using Git 

• Strong communication and teamwork skills, plus a genuine love of problem-solving 

• Excitement about building your professional portfolio and growing your network 

• A proactive, collaborative mindset and a drive to learn and innovate 
 
 Bonus Points 

• Public-facing sites, apps, or demos you've built yourself (we'd love to see them!) 

• Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) or modern software frameworks 

• Experience building with AI tools, LLM APIs, or AI coding assistants 
 
 Why Intern with Capital Technology Group? 

• 💰 Get paid to learn: a competitive stipend of $800.00 to $900.00 per week, depending on candidate qualifications 

• 🚀 Do work that matters: contribute to impactful projects that make a real difference 

• 💻 Level up your skills: get hands-on with modern software development tools and technologies 

• 🧭 Learn from the best: career mentorship from experienced professionals who want to see you thrive 

• 🌐 Grow your network: connect with engineers, leaders, and a cohort of fellow interns 

• 🎉 Have fun doing it: share laughs, celebrate wins, and enjoy the ride with a team that values innovation, learning, and growth 
 
 Sound like your kind of summer? Apply today and let's build something great together! 

 Full Time Employee Benefits

• Remote Work (Hybrid roles will be specified in the job post) 

• Competitive Compensation Package 

• Medical, Dental, and Vision 

• Life Insurance, Short/Long Term Disability 

• Employee Assistance Program 

• 401(k) with 4% matching 

• Liberal PTO vacation policy 

• Generous Annual Continuing Education 

• Annual Wellness Budget 

• Bonus Incentive Programs (Employee referrals and performance-based rewards) 
 
 Thanks for your interest in Capital Technology Group! 

 Capital Technology Group is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
fit_why: Full-stack/Python/React intern work; requires Java or Python, React, Git

Overview

 The Lifeway Internship Program is a unique opportunity designed to provide college students and recent graduates with a valuable learning experience that fosters growth both professionally, personally, and spiritually. Our internships go far beyond "busy work"—you’ll engage in meaningful projects, gain hands-on experience, and be empowered to make an impact. Interns at Lifeway receive professional development, have opportunities for exposure to senior leaders, and benefit from mentoring relationships with experts in their chosen field.

 Job Overview 

 This intern joins the Accounts & Organizational Management (AOM) team and support the development of the new lifeway.com/account experience. They will own front-end projects focused on rebuilding and enhancing account management features, improving the user experience, and implementing post-launch UI improvements planned for Winter-Spring 2027. Deliverables include front-end development, interface enhancements, testing, and collaboration with product and design teams to create a better experience for Lifeway users.

 Internship Program Details & Requirements

• Compensation : Lifeway’s summer internship program offers a competitive hourly pay rate, and all necessary equipment is provided. 
 
• Work Schedule : Interns work an average of 32 hours per week, with core workdays from Tuesday to Thursday. The expectation is that the internship is the primary focus during working hours. 
 
• Program Duration : June 7 - August 11, 2027 (11 weeks). Interns must commit to participating in the entire program. 
 
• Eligibility : Candidates must be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and have completed at least two years of study by the internship start date. Recent graduates (December 2026 or May 2027) are also eligible. 
 
• Development Opportunities : Weekly professional development sessions are provided, including specialized training, mentorship, and leadership development. 
 
• Remote Structure : This is a remote position in the U.S., with required in-person attendance for orientation (June 7 - 11, 2027) and end-of-summer presentations (August 9-11, 2027) in Nashville. Travel costs for these events are covered by Lifeway. 
 
• Application Deadline : Applications are due by December 31, with interviews beginning as soon as possible. Selections are finalized by April 1. 
 
 Explore our culture further at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

 This is a remote position based in the contiguous 48 United States with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings. #LI-Remote 

 Responsibilities

• Live out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work 
 
• Develop and enhance front-end features for the new lifeway.com/account experience that replaces my.lifeway.com 
 
• Build, test, and maintain user interface components and account management features

• Own front-end projects focused on rebuilding account management features and improving the user experience

• Implement post-launch UI improvements to the account experience    

• Collaborate with engineering, product, and design team members to deliver a better experience for Lifeway users

• Take part in code reviews, testing, debugging, and documentation

• Overnight travel for Orientation, and Final Presentation weeks 
 
 Qualifications

 Education 

 Pursuing a Computer Science degree

 Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, required 

 •     Working knowledge of front-end web development technologies, with an emphasis on experience in JavaScript

 •     Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

 •     Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members

 •     Eagerness to learn new technologies and contribute in a team-oriented environment

 Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

 Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred  

 •     Experience building web applications through coursework, personal projects, or internships

 •     Basic understanding of responsive design and user experience principles
